name: comp-365

frames.best_why: Hover card is open under the thumbnail with title, summary, read time and its upward pointer.

tagline: Hovering a thumbnail unfurls a note with article title, summary and read time.
summary: A small rounded card holds an article thumbnail beside its title and a hover hint. Hovering the thumbnail opens a wider popup with the full headline, a summary, read time and last-updated date.
appearance: Inside a dark rounded card, a small photo thumbnail sits left of a bold 'Building a Design System' label and a faint caption. Hovering opens a dark popup below with an upward pointer, a bold two-line headline, grey summary text and a small '8 min read · Updated 2 days ago' line.
behaviour: Hovering the thumbnail opens the popup with a short delay; moving the pointer onto the popup keeps it open, and leaving fades it out. The thumbnail is a link.
demo_content: Thumbnail photo; card says 'Building a Design System'; popup has the full title, summary and 8 min read.
search_phrases: hover a thumbnail to preview an article
small image that opens a summary card
read time and updated date on hover
hover card with headline and excerpt
use_when: A linked thumbnail needs to preview the article before a reader commits to opening it.
avoid_when: Hover-only previews are inaccessible on touch devices and the popup can be clipped near a screen edge.
customise: The image URL, headline, summary and meta line are fixed inside the file; real articles require editing them or replacing the markup.
weight_why: One small popup with text and an image; nothing runs until hover.

a11y.note: The link opens the card on focus, but the image alt is only 'Content' and the popup text is not tied to the trigger as a description.

issues: The image alt text is only the word 'Content'.
The hover card is fixed at 320px and can overflow a narrow column.
In frame 4 the popup sits well below-left with no visible pointer.
polish_why: Tidy card and popup; the tiny thumbnail and offset popup keep it ordinary.
